atoms.b: George draws on everything. From the time he could hold a pen, he was drawing on walls, floors, paper, his bed and sometimes even on himself. He loves making new drawings for all his friends and family.

atoms.b: George likes to draw everything. He draws his cat, Fina and his best friend, Fred. He tries to draw what he can see and also things from his imagination.

instruction.text: Choose which picture fits the text best.

atoms.b: George feels better after drawing. If he is ever upset, all he needs to do is make a new drawing, and he feels better. He can always forget about other things while making art.

atoms.b: George wants to paint more. He wants to learn about colours and different kinds of paints. He likes to find new ways to create and express himself.
